resolved.title: 警告
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The Alert Box[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

JavaScript offers three types of popup boxes, the [b]Alert[/b], [b]Prompt[/b], and [b]Confirm [/b]boxes.

[s0l0!-header][h2]Alert Box[/h2][/s0l0!-header] 
An[b] alert box[/b] is used when you want to ensure that information gets through to the user.
When an alert box pops up, the user must click OK to proceed.
The [b]alert [/b]function takes a single parameter, which is the text displayed in the popup box.
[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="682"][b]alert[/b]("Do you really want to leave this page?"); [/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2760" width="100%"]
To display [b]line breaks[/b] within a popup box, use a backslash followed by the character n.[code format="js" codeId="683"]alert("Hello[b]\n[/b]How are you?");[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]Result:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [img id="2761" width="100%"]
[note]Be careful when using alert boxes, as the user can continue using the page only after clicking OK.[/note]

resolved.title: 提示框
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Prompt Box[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]prompt box[/b] is often used to have the user input a value before entering a page.
When a prompt box pops up, the user will have to click either OK or Cancel to proceed after entering the input value.
If the user clicks OK, the box[b] returns the input value[/b]. If the user clicks Cancel, the box returns [b]null[/b].

The [b]prompt()[/b] method takes [b]two parameters[/b]. 
- The first is the label, which you want to display in the text box.
- The second is a default string to display in the text box (optional).

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="js" codeId="684"]var user = prompt("Please enter your name");
alert(user);[/code]
[s0l0!-header][b]The prompt appears as: [/b][/s0l0!-header][img id="2762" width="100%"]
[note]When a prompt box pops up, the user will have to click either "OK" or "Cancel" to proceed after entering an input value. Do not overuse this method, because it prevents the user from accessing other parts of the page until the box is closed.[/note]

**提示框**经常被用来让用户在进入一个页面之前输入一个值。
当提示框弹出时，用户在输入数值后必须点击确定或取消来继续。
如果用户点击确定，提示框**返回输入值**。如果用户点击了 "取消"，盒子就会返回空值**null**。

**prompt()** 方法需要**两个参数**。
- 第一个是标签，你想在文本框中显示它。
- 第二个是一个默认的字符串，显示在文本框中（可选）。

**例子：**
content.text_html:
A prompt box is often used to have the user input a value before entering a page. When a prompt box pops up, the user will have to click either OK or Cancel to proceed after entering the input value. If the user clicks OK, the box** returns the input value**. If the user clicks Cancel, the box returns null.

The prompt() method takes two parameters.

  • The first is the label, which you want to display in the text box.
  • The second is a default string to display in the text box (optional).

Example:

一个提示框经常被用来让用户在进入一个页面之前输入一个值。 当提示框弹出时，用户在输入数值后必须点击确定或取消来继续。 如果用户点击确定，提示框返回输入值。如果用户点击了 "取消"，盒子就会返回**空。

prompt()方法需要两个参数。

  • 第一个是标签，你想在文本框中显示它。
  • 第二个是一个默认的字符串，显示在文本框中（可选）。

例子：

content.js_code:
var user = prompt("输入你的名字", "张三");
alert(user);

content.text: 当一个提示框弹出时，用户在输入一个输入值后必须点击 "确定" 或 "取消" 来继续。不要过度使用这种方法，因为弹出时，用户无法使用页面的其他部分。
content.text_html:
When a prompt box pops up, the user will have to click either "OK" or "Cancel" to proceed after entering an input value. Do not overuse this method, because it prevents the user from accessing other parts of the page until the box is closed.

如果用户点击了 "确定"，弹窗就会返回**true**。如果用户点击 "取消"，盒子就会返回**false**。
